decisions.what: The bot lives in bindery-ra2-adapter as the net8.0 projects src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot, .Sim and .Claude, tools/Bindery.Ra2.Bot.Arena and tests/Bindery.Ra2.Bot.Tests.
decisions.why: The repo already owns the RA2 telemetry seam (ra2yrcpp). The bot is engine-agnostic so it builds and tests on Linux.

decisions.what: One optional strategic LLM (claude-opus-5, low effort) that only selects and parameterises validated playbooks. The 'fast LLM' exists only as the llm+fast arm (Haiku, parameter changes only).
decisions.why: The proposal's verdict: keep the AI layered, but don't make the LLM layers the default.

decisions.what: A deterministic region-level simulator is the development and evaluation environment; the retail RA2 path goes through the ra2yrcpp telemetry and command-envelope seams (bindery.ra2.bot-observation/v1, bindery.ra2.bot-command/v1).
decisions.why: The native command RPC belongs to the ra2yrcpp fork. The simulator gives observe, act, reset, replay and logging offline.

decisions.what: The contracts in src/Bindery.Ra2.Bot/Contracts are fixed; the integrator made small changes (BotJson named floats and RegionId dictionary keys, ObservationFrame.OreRemaining, BeliefSnapshot.OreLastSeen).
decisions.why: Parallel packages needed a single source of truth; the changes answered verified package requests.
